title: ANTHROSCORE: A Computational Linguistic Measure of Anthropomorphism
benchmark_measurement: The paper uses LIWC-22 for construct validity analysis. In this context, it measures the prevalence of terms related to the 'Lifestyle' dimension, which includes words about work, home, religion, money, and leisure, in high versus low anthropomorphism sentences.
findings: The paper found no direct findings about religion. As part of a validity check using LIWC, it found that sentences with high anthropomorphism scores had a statistically significant higher prevalence of words from the 'Lifestyle' dimension, which is a broad category that includes terms related to work, home, religion, money, and leisure.
